environment.browser: local web server, ordinary Better Auth member session

scopeDecision.decision: Include forms, project dependencies, and initiative links as well as standard issue/project templates, milestones and nested issues.

evidence: Concurrent exact retries create one issue tree and one receipt/audit per command.
A second distinct key creates a second tree with expected content, assignment, priority, estimates and child properties.
Browser drops the committed creation response, reloads, and retries its private journal without duplicating the tree.
Project application creates fresh milestone identities, canonical issue membership, both dependency directions, and initiative membership atomically.

Unavailable/deleted issue status, inaccessible/deleted team, departed assignee, hidden dependency, invalid form answers and stale template revision return repairable validation without objects or receipts.
Invalid nested issue, a dependency cycle, or invalid initiative rolls back the entire project setup.
Browser repairs an invalid reference and a stale chosen revision before creating a real project.

additionalChecks: Six form field types and required answers validated on the server; answers persisted in canonical rich/plain descriptions.
Source/workspace/visibility and feature-gate checks; live replay authorization after revocation.
Template deletion after a committed effect denies replay without replacing its identity.
Deferred COMMIT fault is not reported as a validation rollback; an exact retry safely resolves its outcome.
Existing member/non-member defaults, cross-kind preselection and triage behavior.
Unreadable existing dependency links survive an authorized edit without disclosure.
Template management and application share the workspace/definition lock order.
